data.name: Nuvio
data.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
data.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
